reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph, so no invalid or directionally wrong edit is introduced.

Section 12.1 sets a single term running until expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations, with no automatic renewal, no renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic — so there is no auto-renewal exit or pricing risk for the RENEWAL rule to address.
The failed deterministic check ('number not found' for a ≤60-day notice window) is consistent with the absence of any renewal notice mechanic rather than evidence of a deviation.

Rationale correctly notes the customer-side position is at least as good as preferred (no unilateral automatic extension binding us) and that Sanofi retains broad termination rights under 12.2(a); retaining this as internal compliance evidence rather than a negotiation issue is appropriate.
